body.name: Upper same-law endpoint construction
body.construction: For fixed \((p,t)\), enumerate all pairs \((j_0,j_1)\) on \(\mathcal Y\). For each pair, impose in \(\Xi(p)\) the weak threshold inequalities at \(j_0,j_1\), introduce one common slack below \(t\) for every applicable predecessor inequality, and maximize that slack; declare the pair feasible exactly when the optimum is positive, with no predecessor constraint at \(j_a=1\). Choose a feasible pair maximizing \(y_{j_1}-y_{j_0}\), choose the lexicographically least basic maximizer of its positive-slack program, and let \(P_t^+(p)\) be the induced law.
